name: MoltSets
summary: B2B people and company search, email and mobile lookup, email validation and reverse lookups.

api_key.description: a MoltSets API key, ms_... (app.moltsets.com > API keys)

notes: Every call is a POST with a JSON body to /<tool_name>; reads are still POSTs. A non-empty User-Agent header is required (this entry sends one).
Completed calls answer HTTP 200 with {results, status: ok|not_found, metadata}. Misses are uncharged but count as a request against fair-use limits shown in metadata.fair_use.
Plans cap records and requests in rolling 5-hour and weekly windows; some tools are plan-restricted.
The ad-audience tools (hashed emails, MAIDs) and website scraping are not listed here.

endpoints.name: Get account details
endpoints.summary: Plan, status, token balance, fair-use standing, phone token balance and key count.
notes: A read over POST (every MoltSets call is a POST); the body is empty.

endpoints.name: Get usage breakdown
endpoints.summary: Day-by-day calls, credits used, hits, misses and failures for a period.
notes: A read over POST.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: People search by title, company, location, seniority, industry, department and employer size, with exclusions.

query.description: Full-text over name, company, title and headline.

title.description: Job title filter; the precise way to search by role. A single value, or an array for any-of.

company.description: Employer name filter; every word must appear in the name. A single value, or an array for any-of.

company_domain.description: Employer website domain; URLs are normalized. A single value, or an array for any-of.

country.description: Exact country name. A single value, or an array for any-of.

state.description: State or region, full name or abbreviation. A single value, or an array for any-of.

city.description: Exact city name, standard capitalization. A single value, or an array for any-of.

seniority.description: Seniority level, one of: Intern, Entry, Senior, Manager, Director, VP, Head, C Suite, Owner, Partner. Note 'C Suite' has a space. A single value, or an array for any-of.

industry.description: One of 22 fixed industry buckets, matched exactly; see the docs for the list. A single value, or an array for any-of.

department.description: Exact department; shares data with functional_area, use one or the other. A single value, or an array for any-of.

functional_area.description: Exact functional area; shares data with department. A single value, or an array for any-of.

employee_range.description: Employer size band, one of: 1-10, 11-20, 21-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001+. A single value, or an array for any-of.

revenue_range.description: Employer revenue band, one of: Below $500k; $500k - $1M; $1M - $5M; $5M - $10M; $10M - $20M; $20M - $50M; Above $50M. A single value, or an array for any-of.

naics_code.description: NAICS code of the employer at any level, 2 to 6 digits. A single value, or an array for any-of.

linkedin_industry.description: LinkedIn's own industry label of the employer. A single value, or an array for any-of.

exclude_company_domain.description: Employer domains to drop (a suppression list).

notes: A read over POST: the filters are in the body. All filters are exact-match except query, title and company.
Billed per record returned; the free plan caps a call at 10 records. Searches count against a per-plan concurrent-search limit (3 to 8); over it answers 429 search_concurrency_exceeded.
Emails come back in the search results.
Branch on status ('ok' or 'not_found') rather than the HTTP code; a not_found miss is uncharged but counts as one request.
